description: The smallest set of independent facts a component must remember. Everything else is derived during render.
Computed from props or state on every render, e.g. `const unread = items.filter((item) => !item.read).length`.
Store `selectedId` and look the object up, instead of storing a copy that goes stale.
`useState(() => compute())` runs `compute` only on the first render.
Naming convention for props that only seed local state; later changes are ignored by design. Pair with a `key` to reset.
